question_text: What is the name of the President of the United States now?

official_answers.text: Visit uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates for the name of the President of the United States.

why_it_matters.text: The President is the head of the executive branch and Commander in Chief of the military. They sign or veto bills, appoint federal judges, and lead American foreign policy.

fun_fact.text: The presidential oath is only 35 words: starting with 'I do solemnly swear that I will faithfully execute the Office of President...'
